scope: Theorem 4.1 (Local matching representation) of the manuscript “An exponential two-way deterministic state lower bound for one-way liveness” (preprints/An-exponential-two-way-deterministic-state-lower-bound-for-one-way-liveness-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 129 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 612819217a292910), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every s-state deterministic machine in this model, there is a map η : Σ ∪ {⊢, ⊣} −→ Dk, k = 4(s + 1)2 , with the following property. Designate ports 1, 2 on each of the two sides as test ports. For every word w = a1 · · · aℓ, the machine accepts w if and only if the diagram η(⊢)η(a1) · · · η(aℓ)η(⊣) pairs a left test port with a right test port. Each symbol diagram is independent of the input length, the symbol’s position, and its neighboring symbols. If acceptance instead requires entry into an accepting state after a positive number of transitions, the same conclusion holds with k = 4(s + 2)2.
